initialFailures: Browser-generated click coordinates rounded to integer CSS pixels. Replaced impossible exact UI numeric assertions with explicit bounded tolerances (0.3m for 50m, 2m² for 100m², 0.2m for 10m and 20m clip); exact native geometry remains covered by Node tests.
Harness waited on server state before zone DOM refresh; now waits for both.
Harness used measurement_id instead of quantitySchedule source_id; corrected.
Count pan harness left its synthetic click suppression pending; measurement test consumes the matching inactive click before drawing.
Unscaled harness initially treated Opening as ready and then reopened an already selected sheet; corrected waits and avoided redundant switch.
Visual inspection exposed inherited #calibrate width:100% overriding class rule; fixed ID specificity and confirmed no horizontal control overflow in 18 layouts.
limitations: No persistent measurement headings/groups, itemisation or dominant-zone itemised allocation
No PDF-edge snapping, snap-length lock, global Save/undo or full Countfire parity
Measurements remain independent saved geometry records and immediate writes; scale is calibrated by known length
Draft cursor preview does not calculate or commit live quantities
Final UI tests validate owned simple corpus; no actual estimator usability study or representative production performance benchmark
